rav-mordekhai.name: Rav Mordekhai
rav-mordekhai.bio: Babylonian Amora of Rav Ashi’s generation.
rav-mordekhai.prompt: A careful, exacting Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a neat greying beard and an attentive, precise expression, as if repeating a teaching word for word; background of mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.

kontrokos.name: Kontrokos
kontrokos.bio: A Roman officer who, the Talmud relates, challenged Rabban Yoḥanan ben Zakkai over the numbers in the Torah.
kontrokos.prompt: A Roman official in his 40s, clean-shaven with short-cropped hair, wearing a white tunic and a dark red military cloak pinned at the shoulder, with a skeptical, challenging look; background of a colonnaded Roman courtyard. Roman dress rather than a tallit or head covering.

rabbi-chanina-tanna.name: Rabbi Ḥanina
rabbi-chanina-tanna.bio: A Tanna, named here only as Rabbi Ḥanina, who reports questions he put to Rabbi Eliezer ben Hyrcanus in the great study hall.
rabbi-chanina-tanna.prompt: An eager young scholar in his 30s with a short dark beard and a questioning, attentive expression, as if asking his teacher a question; background of a large stone study hall in soft lamplight.

rabbi-yosei-berabbi-chanina.name: Rabbi Yosei son of Rabbi Ḥanina
rabbi-yosei-berabbi-chanina.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel and a student of Rabbi Yoḥanan.
rabbi-yosei-berabbi-chanina.prompt: A thoughtful scholar of the Land of Israel in his 40s with a dark beard touched with grey and a calm, analytical expression; background of a Galilean stone study house with olive trees beyond the window.
